question: A strip of four square panels labeled 1-2-3-4 is wrapped around the side faces of a cube so that panel 1 is front, panel 2 is right, panel 3 is back, and panel 4 is left; the top and bottom are unmarked. The cube is then rolled once to the right (top moves to right) and once forward (top moves to front). Which pair is on the TOP and FRONT at the end?
explanation: Initially, Panel 1 is Front, Panel 2 is Right, Panel 3 is Back, and Panel 4 is Left. When the cube rolls once to the right, Panel 1 moves to the Left, Panel 2 moves to the Front, Panel 3 moves to the Right, and Panel 4 moves to the Back; the original Right face (Panel 2) becomes the new Front, and the original Top face becomes the new Right face. When it then rolls once forward, the new Front face (Panel 2) moves to the Bottom, the new Top face moves to the Front, and the new Back face (Panel 4) moves to the Top. Therefore, Panel 3 (which was initially Back, then Right after the first roll) will be on the Top, and Panel 4 (which was initially Left, then Back after the first roll) will be on the Front.
